title: strip_did_sig_header belongs in did_passthrough
description: strip_did_sig_header in did_verify.rs does header-level byte manipulation and explicitly cross-references did_passthrough::DID_SIG_HEADER to do it. Header extraction and filtering are did_passthrough.rs's job; did_verify.rs should call a function exported from did_passthrough rather than doing the filtering itself. Move strip_did_sig_header (and export it, or give verify_did_sig a stripped-bytes parameter) so did_verify.rs contains only crypto logic and the module boundary matches the intended separation.
